regime_extension: K=2: endpoints (indices 0,3); K=8,16: repeat each K4 entry K/4 times. Preserve exact K4 vectors.

heterogeneous.distribution: equal-weight mixture of independent Beta(0.5,0.5), Beta(2,2), Beta(8,8), Beta(0.5,3), Beta(3,0.5), and logistic-normal: group location N(0,1), log-scale Uniform(log(0.15),log(3)), independent standard-normal coordinates
heterogeneous.sampling: 16 independent vectors per component per K; stratified equal mixture; no winner-based filtering

exact: all K=2 cells and K4/B16/m0=2 six regimes
paired_MC: shared pilots and independent fresh Bernoulli streams indexed by thought; all allocations consume prefixes of the same main stream
primary_comparison: JADA versus variance-only, both budget-precommitted reuse, mean over heterogeneous vectors and feasible cells, equally weighted K then feasible cells within K
intervals: 95% paired normal intervals for fixed-vector Monte Carlo; stratified vector-level Student-t intervals for population mixture, preserving all cells in each vector cluster; delta-method relative MSE reduction intervals
gate_rule: Conservative operationalization of clearly improves: primary relative reduction lower 95% confidence limit > 5%; each K point estimate >0; pooled matched-reuse uniform comparison >0. Otherwise no-go or inconclusive. This 5% rule is new, not a threshold quoted from the proposal.
scope: Bernoulli estimator evidence only; GPU hours and GPU cost zero
